payload.claim: Problem-section step 4 instructs, in one sentence, to move the row count to 75 and assert FINDINGS is empty in tests/test_events.py, but never names the existing test that second clause must edit. The only place asserting FINDINGS size today is test_findings_name_what_the_table_could_not_type (assert len(FINDINGS) == 1, lines 2093-2098), which the Context section cites only by line range, not by name. A cell that treats the Problem section prose as the complete literal edit list without cross-referencing that citation could leave assert len(FINDINGS) == 1 in place, which fails outright once FINDINGS is emptied, breaking the tests gate independent of whether every acceptance criterion's own witness passes. Since this is not tied to a specific acceptance entry, this is a concern for the operator to confirm the cell catches it, rather than a tagged blocker.
